user.title: Connect Bloomery
user.description: In Bloomery open **Profile → Home Assistant & calendar**, tap **Create feed** and paste the integration URL here.

reconfigure.title: Update Bloomery link
reconfigure.description: Paste the new integration URL from Bloomery (needed after tapping **New token**).

error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a Bloomery integration URL (…/api/ha/TOKEN).
error.invalid_token: This link is no longer active. Create a new one in Bloomery.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach Bloomery at that address from Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This Bloomery account is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That link belongs to a different Bloomery account.
